text:
Marta: Canary rolled to subset canary-7 at 03:30 UTC. Seeing ~18% throughput drop on NF4+packing path and a ~600MB jitter in KV shard memory. Anyone else seeing this?
Jason: Yep, noticed on canary-7. p50 looks ok but p95 and tail latency spiked. Any logs yet?
Marta: Perf agent sampled a few runs, pasted snippet below:
```
# perf snippet
canary-7 | model: gpt-8k-nf4 | toks/sec: 1120 -> 920
kv_evictions: 42 -> 320
host_mem_delta: +600MB
kernel_choice: q4_pack_fast -> q4_pack_slow
```
perf-bot: Deploy bot: Canary deployed by @Marta to canary-7 (NF4 + packing).
Lee: Is this the microbatching heuristic change from PR #422? We started favoring microbatches (thin-plateau window) for short sequences.
Marta: Yes, PR 422 changed the batch window to prefer microbatches when seq_len < 128. Suspect interaction with packing -> more frequent KV swaps.
Nav: I ran a quick nvprof sample. Kernel selector flips to a slow int4 fallback when mixed layout detected for microbatches. Seems to thrash L2. Will upload trace.
Alice: Also seeing additional host<->device memcpy spikes when prefetcher mispredicts shard affinity.
Jason: Hypothesis: packing + microbatches -> increased KV fragmentation -> more evictions + memcpy churn -> throughput drop.
Lee: Can we rollback the microbatch heuristic on canary? Or add a runtime flag to bypass packing to confirm? We should bisect.
Marta: Starting bisect: disabling packing on one canary shard now.
Ops Bot: Rolling change queued; need owner approval to proceed to remaining canaries.
Marta: Early results: disabling packing recovered toks/sec to baseline and memory stabilized. So packing + microbatch interaction is likely root cause.
Nav: Filing perf bug with nvprof traces and kernel dumps. Suspect kernel chooser hits q4-neon variant that is bad for seq < 64. Assigning to eng-runtime/kernel.
Jason: Next steps: test alternate kernel selector heuristics - prefer q4_dense for seq < 128 and hard-affinity for KV hot shards. Also try increasing microbatch coalescing threshold.
Lee: I'll add lightweight telemetry to emit kernel_choice, microbatch_size, and kv_shard_id per request (sampled 1/200). Quick patch incoming.
Alice: Add detailed KV eviction reason codes to telemetry — current counter only reports generic evict++ which isn't useful.
Marta: Thanks. Pausing full rollout until selector + telemetry patch lands. +1 on per-request kernel telemetry.
perf-bot: Created perf alert PERF-5567 and linked this thread.
Jason: Also, schedule a small controlled load test with seq distribution skewed to <64, 64-256, >256 to validate.
Marta: Agreed. We'll run that after Lee's telemetry patch and Nav's tracer annotations are in.
Lee: Patch opened: #431 (kernel-telemetry + microbatch metric). Canary launch blocked until results.
Marta: Great. Thanks team.
